snippet.title: Dome Keeper | Xbox Game Pass Announcement
snippet.description:
Dome Keeper is coming to Xbox PC, Xbox Series X|S, Cloud, XPA  and Game Pass, December 9! 

Dome Keeper is an innovative roguelike survival miner game where players defend against waves of alien attackers, dig for resources and choose from powerful upgrade paths. Players must use the time between attacks to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources and relics – and deliver them back to their dome to unlock powerful upgrades and useful new gadgets.
